$comment: The order of the products and the wording of their status on the org profile. Structure (name, url, status, repo) and each product's one line come from @krizaka/ui/sites. `statusLabels` maps a site status to the words krizaka.com shows (lib/products.ts: Orazaka and Orochia are « Dev preview »). A product listed with a `fallback` is shown from it until the published @krizaka/ui/sites knows it.
